LOG=/private/tmp/claude-501/-/878caa08-6b06-497e-8e8f-f501167a423a/scratchpad
mkdir -p "$LOG"
npx tsc -b --pretty false > "$LOG/typecheck.log" 2>&1; tc=$?
tail -40 "$LOG/typecheck.log"
echo "typecheck exit: $tc"
npm run build > "$LOG/build.log" 2>&1; bd=$?
tail -30 "$LOG/build.log"
echo "build exit: $bd"
